operations.title: Second maximal-rank replication of the ternary cubic infinity obstruction
operations.body: At (p,z)=(1019,13), affine rank 1152 and kernel dimension 769 replicate. Cross and complement pairs reproduce ranks 617 and 550 and remain consistent; both inequivalent triples reproduce rank 769 and remain inconsistent.

operations.title: Entry 1364's modular ternary minimality is independent of the tested base value
operations.body: The one-characteristic modular pattern occurs at both z=7 and z=13. Cross-characteristic and characteristic-zero certification remain open.
